question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**moment**" means a very brief period of time. (क्षण)
 
• The context suggests that Nicole was looking down at the Mediterranean for a brief period.
 
• The other options: "**occasion**," "**time**," and "**minute**" do not fit as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** For a moment__ Nicole stood looking down at the Mediterranean but there was................"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Occasion (अवसर)**: means a particular event or time.
 
• **Time (समय)**: means the indefinite continued progress of existence and events in the past, present, and future regarded as a whole.
 
• **Minute (मिनट)**: means a period of time equal to sixty seconds.
